artist.name: Cole Norton
artist.short_description: Cole Norton — an Afterglow editorial selection for listeners exploring acoustic pop.
artist.biography: Cole Norton is a recording artist whose streaming catalogue combines original-seeming singer-songwriter material with renditions of previously released popular songs. Spotify lists recordings including ‘Perfect’, ‘Malibu Nights’, ‘Someone You Loved’, ‘Falling Like the Stars’, ‘Nobody Else’ and ‘Run’. A separate release chronology identifies ‘Nobody Else’ in 2020 and ‘Run’ in 2021. This blend makes his Afterglow profile different from a straightforward songwriter catalogue: a song credited as a Cole Norton recording is not necessarily a composition he wrote. Covers and remixes must be labeled as such once authorship and master-recording details are separately verified. The available sources establish the existence of identifiable recordings, but provide insufficient reliable personal background to state a nationality, birth name or home city. For discovery purposes, his catalogue can sit alongside piano-led and acoustic emotional-pop performers whose appeal is built around intimate vocal delivery. That stylistic assessment is editorial rather than a documented artist statement. Until better first-person interviews are found, individual song explanations should remain unavailable rather than attributed to him without evidence.
